_comment: 52 Weeks of Firsts: Retirement Edition. Fifty-two weekly prompts, one new thing to try each week, each printed with a date line and writing lines for notes. The weeks are numbered, not dated, so the reader can start any week of the year: nothing seasonal or calendar-bound (seasonalTerms), and nothing that sounds like an order (pressureTerms). Variety is structural: the year is spread over eighteen areas (every area appears; the mix's boost areas take four weeks, the rest two or three, never more than areaMax), every idea gets its own facet and flavour, shuffled by seed. Bigger outings -- far travel, strenuous or costly ideas (stretchTerms) -- are allowed but capped per year (stretchMax), so the year stays open to every budget and body. fillerWords are the 'never tried before' padding every first carries; they are ignored when two ideas are compared. Idea shape, safety and meaning-level repeats reuse the Bucket List's gates (bucket-list/prompt.json).

locale.nativeLine: - Write in clear, warm, natural English that reads well in both British and American homes.
locale.otherLine: - Write every idea in language locale '{locale}', natural for that language, keeping each idea one short action.
